# `aitbc energy provider profile`

Read a registered energy profile (EVM contract or native rail).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc energy provider profile [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--resource-id` | text | — | yes | Canonical resource ID |
| `--json-output` | flag | `false` | no | Output raw JSON |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc energy provider profile --resource-id <resource_id>
```
